The [example](example/index.md) is rendered from this Markdown. The same
file drives the test suite.

``` {.markdown include="../tests/model-source.md"}
```

## LaTeX output

For LaTeX, the filter emits `amsthm` environments, and loads the package
and declares them in the preamble, so the output has to be standalone:

```sh
pandoc -L amsthm.lua model-source.md --top-level-division=chapter -N -s -o model-latex.tex
```

Below is the same output, minus pandoc's default template, which is how
the golden test keeps it comparable across pandoc versions: what the
filter adds to the preamble, followed by the body.

``` {.latex include="../tests/model-latex.tex"}
```

The [example](example/index.md) also links a PDF typeset from it by
Quarto.
